column1: Geser: layar jadi trackpad. Ketuk: jari langsung jadi kursor.
column2: Slide: the screen acts as a trackpad. Tap: your finger becomes the cursor directly.

column1: Minecraft akan dihentikan dan kamu kembali ke launcher. Dunia yang belum tersimpan bisa hilang.
column2: Minecraft will be stopped and you will return to the launcher. Unsaved worlds may be lost.

column1: Ketuk ikon gerigi atau angka FPS di layar untuk membuka menu. Keluar dari game lewat tombol merah di dalam menu.
column2: Tap the gear icon or the FPS number on screen to open the menu. Exit the game with the red button inside the menu.

column1: Bug itu hal yang biasa, karena tiada yang sepurna melainkan tuhan yang maha kuasa.
column2: Bugs are normal, because nothing is perfect except God Almighty.

column1: Matikan Vertical Sync (VSync) di pengaturan Renderer jika mengalami stuttering atau layar blank hitam setelah logo Mojang.
column2: Turn off Vertical Sync (VSync) in the Renderer settings if you get stuttering or a black blank screen after the Mojang logo.

column1: Jika tampilan layar Minecraft terpotong atau vertikal, aktifkan rotasi otomatis HP dan posisikan layar mendatar (Landscape) sebelum menekan Mainkan.
column2: If the Minecraft screen looks cropped or vertical, enable your phone's auto-rotate and hold the screen in landscape before pressing Play.

column1: Gunakan MobileGlues Renderer untuk efisiensi baterai dan kompatibilitas shaderpack terbaik.
column2: Use the MobileGlues renderer for the best battery efficiency and shaderpack compatibility.

column1: Jika Minecraft crash saat startup pada GPU Mali/Adreno, coba aktifkan 'DISABLE_SUBGROUP' di pengaturan renderer.
column2: If Minecraft crashes on startup with a Mali/Adreno GPU, try enabling 'DISABLE_SUBGROUP' in the renderer settings.

column1: Aktifkan OpenGL NoError di pengaturan MobileGlues untuk meningkatkan FPS saat bermain.
column2: Enable OpenGL NoError in the MobileGlues settings to improve FPS while playing.

column1: Gunakan tombol HIDE GUI untuk menyembunyikan tombol virtual di layar saat bermain dengan keyboard & mouse fisik.
column2: Use the HIDE GUI button to hide the on-screen buttons when playing with a physical keyboard and mouse.

column1: Atur alokasi RAM sesuai spesifikasi HP: 2GB\u20133GB sudah sangat cukup untuk Minecraft versi 1.20+ tanpa modpack berat.
column2: Set RAM to suit your phone: 2GB\u20133GB is plenty for Minecraft 1.20+ without heavy modpacks.

column1: Ubah sensitivitas kursor di Pengaturan Kontrol untuk membidik dan mengarahkan pandangan lebih akurat.
column2: Change the cursor sensitivity in the Controls settings to aim and look around more accurately.

column1: Pilih Vulkan Driver Turnip di perangkat Snapdragon untuk performa grafis dan stabilitas maksimal.
column2: Choose the Turnip Vulkan driver on Snapdragon devices for the best graphics performance and stability.

column1: Kamu bisa menyesuaikan posisi dan ukuran tombol kontrol sesukamu di menu Kustomisasi Tombol.
column2: You can adjust the position and size of the control buttons as you like in the button customization menu.

column1: Gunakan fitur Import Addon untuk memasang Modpack (.mrpack), Mod (.jar), dan Resource Pack secara instan!
column2: Use the Import Addon feature to install modpacks (.mrpack), mods (.jar), and resource packs instantly!

column1: Tekan tombol ESC di layar untuk membuka pause menu atau kembali ke menu sebelumnya.
column2: Tap the ESC button on screen to open the pause menu or go back to the previous menu.

column1: Tekan tombol F3 untuk melihat informasi koordinat, biome, dan grafik performa FPS di dalam game.
column2: Press the F3 button to see coordinates, biome, and the FPS performance graph in the game.

column1: Aktifkan mode Fullscreen di Pengaturan untuk mengabaikan notch/kamera depan dan memperluas pandangan.
column2: Enable Fullscreen mode in Settings to ignore the notch/front camera and widen your view.

column2: Android will open a settings page. Turn on all-files access for AmberLauncher, then come back here.

column1: Kalau memilih Nanti, game tetap bisa dipakai. Datanya disimpan di folder privat aplikasi yang tidak mudah dibuka lewat pengelola file.
column2: If you choose Later, the game still works. Its data is kept in the app's private folder, which is not easy to open from a file manager.

column2: All worlds, mods, saves, and configuration in this instance will be permanently deleted and cannot be restored.
